packageRules.description: Allow minor updates on the renovate rebuild trigger file, the releases are linear within a major; golang, kubectl, php, python, ruby and scala have one line per minor

Trigger the rebuild once all assets of a GitHub release are uploaded, so a new version isn't published with some of its files missing; other datasources like docker have no release timestamps, so they can't wait
Update pnpm in the rebuild trigger file and the repo's own pnpm in one PR to save CI runs; no separate patch branch, which would split the group
